notes: No tyre stops reported for the leaders (Senna crashed out on lap 67 while leading). Patrese (#6) 'limped round to the pits for repairs' after colliding with Alliot on lap 51 (Motor Sport Jun 1988 https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/june-1988/22/a-minute-error-of-judgement; Wikipedia lap 51); in-lap not given, so not entered.
